title: Price Accuracy Promise Spend Bonus for Finch Circle Shoppers — Merchandise Purchases
content:
**Bonus rule.** On a Price Accuracy Promise correction of a Merchandise Purchases unit, a customer whose Finch Circle qualifying spend posted in the twelve calendar months before the request date (purchase earn entries whose posting date falls less than twelve whole months before it) reaches the upper spend threshold of $2500.00 receives the upper accuracy spend bonus of $10.00; one whose spend reaches the middle spend threshold of $1000.00 but not the upper receives the middle accuracy spend bonus of $5.00. A customer whose spend is below $1000.00 is outside this rule.

The spend is read from the purchase earn entries of the customer's Finch Circle Loyalty Program points ledger, using the qualifying amount of each entry.

## Thresholds on both sides (hypothetical totals)

| Qualifying spend in the twelve months | Bonus |
|---|---|
| $2500.00 | $10.00 — reaches the upper threshold |
| $2499.99 | $5.00 — reaches the middle threshold only |
| $1000.00 | $5.00 |
| $999.99 | outside this rule |

## Which entries count (hypothetical request date 15 August)

An entry posted on 16 August of the previous year is less than twelve whole months before 15 August and counts; one posted on 15 August of the previous year is a full twelve months before it and does not count.
